Hire a fire breather: book the most spectacular fire show in the Netherlands & Belgium

Looking for more than just entertainment — an act that leaves your guests literally breathless? An opening or closing show people will talk about for years? Welcome to the world of Nuno.

Looking for more than just entertainment — an act that leaves your guests literally breathless? An opening or closing show people will talk about for years? Welcome to the world of Nuno.

As one of the most experienced and sought-after fire artists and fakirs in the Benelux, Nuno lifts every event to another level. With more than 15 years of international experience, spectacular TV appearances and an absolute focus on safety, Nuno delivers not a standard fire act but a high-end visual masterpiece — tailored to your venue.

Why event planners choose fire artist Nuno

  • World-class visual spectacle — no small flames, but towering clouds of fire, fire juggling and choreography set to music.
  • 100% safe & certified — professional equipment, safe fuels, and full compliance with permits and safety distances.
  • High-end presentation — sharp costumes, professional conduct and punctual communication. Perfect for corporate events.
  • Flexible — a stage in Amsterdam, a castle garden in Antwerp or an intimate driveway: the show adapts to your location. Curious? Get in touch.

Our fire shows: an explosion of entertainment

  • The Power Act (5–10 min) — a short, explosive show. Ideal as an opener or a spectacular finale.
  • The Full Fire Show (20–30 min) — a building show with fakir elements, body fire, fire breathing and audience interaction.
  • Duo shows — for extra impact, Nuno can be booked together with a female fire artist or dancer.

Indoors (where the venue allows) or outdoors: we bring the wow factor.

Also possible: interactive fire-breathing workshops

Want to do more than watch? Nuno offers unique fire-breathing workshops — an original idea for team building, stag and hen parties or adventurous company outings.

Which events suit Nuno?

  • 🎉 Anniversaries & private parties — exclusive entertainment in your own garden or venue.
  • 🏢 Corporate events — impress clients or staff with a powerful opening.
  • 💍 Weddings — a romantic fire show as an alternative to fireworks (often allowed where fireworks are not!).
  • 🎪 Festivals & events — a visual magnet that works brilliantly on social media.

Ready to set your event on fire?

Don't wait too long to secure your date: Nuno's calendar fills up fast, especially in high season. Check availability & prices, call +31 6 200 207 23 or message via WhatsApp.

Frequently asked questions

Good to know first

Is a fire show safe at my venue?

Yes — safety is priority number one. Nuno works to strict safety protocols, uses professional fuels and equipment, and adapts the show to the available space, indoors or outdoors.

What does it cost to hire a fire breather?

The price depends on the type of show, its duration and the location. Every show is tailor-made, so request a free quote for an exact price.

Can the fire show take place indoors?

Yes, provided the venue meets certain safety requirements such as ceiling height and ventilation. Nuno has developed special acts that can be performed safely indoors, for example with body fire and fakir techniques.

Where does fire breather Nuno perform?

Nuno performs throughout the Netherlands and Belgium — from Amsterdam and Rotterdam to Antwerp and Brussels — and internationally on request. Travel costs are included in the quote.
